title: Speaking — Memorable places
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on memorable places.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
Which part of your area is best for a quiet visit?
Do you go back to places you liked as a child?

part2.topic: Describe a place that felt different when you visited it again.
points: what you noticed on the later visit
part2.closing: and explain how the visit changed what you remembered.

questions: Why do residents and tourists notice different things about the same location?
How can towns preserve a sense of place while allowing development?
How has everyday life connected with memorable places changed for people of different ages?
